{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check status distribution in loyal group
status_counts_loyal = df_loyal['status'].value_counts(dropna=False)
print(status_counts_loyal)

# Now compute conversion rate only among completed orders
completed_loyal = df_loyal[df_loyal['status'] == 'completed']
conversion_rate_loyal_corrected = completed_loyal['converted'].mean()

# Print all required values explicitly
print(f"Total loyal orders: {len(df_loyal)}")
print(f"Completed loyal orders: {len(completed_loyal)}")
print(f"Conversion rate (completed only): {conversion_rate_loyal_corrected}")"}
